name: skill-sync
description: Safely manage a Git-backed library of AI skills across Codex, Claude, and project repositories.

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke:pack
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
